name: comp-232
title: Flag Country Combobox
description: A searchable country picker whose list is split into continent headings, with a flag before every name. Choosing a country closes the panel and fills the trigger with its flag and name.
use: In an address or signup form, when people must find one country quickly from a long list.
avoid: Flags render differently on each platform, and only fourteen countries are included, so a real list needs new data.
a11y: The trigger is a labelled combobox and filtering works from the keyboard; each flag sits inside the option text, so its emoji name may be read as well. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading Select country with a chevron. Opened, a dark panel shows a search field, then small grey continent headings with rows of a flag emoji and a country name.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters rows and their headings, and choosing one closes the panel and updates the trigger. The clip searches japan and ends on Japan.
customise: Countries are grouped in an array in the file, each with a flag and a name; add or edit entries there. The continent headings, placeholder and trigger width are set in the same file.
weight: light: Fourteen short grouped rows in a popup with one brief open animation.
